chunks: Because of their habitual sinfulness, they were drowned and sent to Hell, and did not find any helper other than God.
ai.seo_question: Why were the people of Noah drowned and what does the verse say about their helpers?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the principle of divine justice where the specific accumulation of sins (khaṭi'āt) directly precipitates the physical destruction and subsequent spiritual punishment. It highlights the futility of worldly allies or idols on the Day of Judgment, reinforcing the concept of Tawhid in both creation and salvation. The narrative serves as a warning that despite prolonged prophetic patience, persistent arrogance leads to inevitable exclusion from divine mercy.
